_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. www.airtable.com's public marketing site declares a real token system on :root: --color-primitive-* ramps and --color-brand-* accents, --color-surface/text/border/icon-* semantics, --spacing-*, --radius-*, --type-*, --font-*, --shadow-*/--elevation-*, --motion-*, --border-width-*, and the --theme_* per-section component set (the base .light theme sits at :root; .darkBlue/.darkTeal/... bands scope their own). One theme: prefers-color-scheme does not change the site (themeChecks in raw/css-vars.json) and there is no page dark mode, so there is no dark set. core leaves name their css var; light leaves alias into core or carry a measured value with its source.

faint.source: tertiary text and filter labels; css-var --color-text-tertiary (:root)

accent-deep.source: deeper blue for pressed accents; css-var --color-primitive-blue-600 (:root)

link-deep.source: nav hover links and promo link; css-var --color-text-link-secondary (:root)

border-strong.source: outline buttons and strong borders; css-var --color-border-primary (:root)

focus.source: the 2px keyboard-focus ring on nav and buttons; css-var --color-primitive-opacity-darken-5 (:root)

focus-field.source: measured outlineColor of text-field / select-field / filter-section at focus-visible (1px)

button-primary-bg.source: measured backgroundColor of nav-signup / hero-cta-primary / submit-button

button-primary-fg.source: measured color of the same buttons

button-primary-hover-bg.source: measured backgroundColor of nav-signup / hero-cta-primary at hover

button-primary-pressed-bg.source: measured backgroundColor of nav-signup / hero-cta-primary at pressed

button-primary-radius.source: measured radius of nav-signup / hero-cta-primary / submit-button

button-outline-pressed-bg.source: measured backgroundColor of nav-demo / hero-cta-secondary at pressed

button-small-radius.source: measured radius of platform-cta (the Try it now / Book demo buttons on platform pages)

link-hover.source: measured color of nav-trigger / promo-link at hover and pressed

nav-height.source: measured height of nav-bar (promo bar 42.5px + header ~79px)

card-hover-bg.source: measured backgroundColor of platform-card at hover

card-radius.source: measured radius of solutions-card (the marketplace tiles run 12px, the plan tiles 32px)

card-tile-radius.source: measured radius of tile-card / resource-card (the coloured path-to-10x tiles)

card-mini-radius.source: measured radius of whatsnew-item release cards

field-border.source: the field box border; css-var --color-border-keyline (:root) — the visible border is painted by the field container, not the input

field-focus.source: measured outlineColor of text-field / country-selector at focus-visible (1px)

field-height.source: measured height of select-field in the contact-sales form

chip-blue-bg.source: measured backgroundColor of the light-blue tile-card

chip-blue-fg.source: measured color of the light-blue tile-card
chip-blue-fg.description: dark green text on the blue tile

plan-highlight-bg.source: measured backgroundColor of plan-card (the recommended column)

plan-cta-focus.source: measured outlineColor of plan-cta at focus-visible (1px)

carousel-ring.source: measured 1px borderColor of the stories carousel arrows on the dark band

carousel-ring-hover.source: measured borderColor of the stories carousel arrows at hover
